featured_reviews.name: Afzal Mohhamad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros: Nearest to marine lines station.That's it.

Cons: On 4th floor

Rooms size of matchboxes with costs of 3bhk.

They don't allow outside food inside the hostel, umm sorry I didn't know this was a movie theater that you are not allowing outside food.

1 unit electricity at 18Rs. Please note the reading or click a pic of the meter otherwise god help you.

Water is chargeable. Yes drinking water in a hostel is not free because it is a luxury.

Food per plate is 150rs. Guess I'll sleep empty stomach for half the month with these rates.

Staff. So professional and friendly. NOT.

FULL DISCLOSURE - I paid 15k for a 4 sharing matchbox. No meals included. No water taken by me because it is dispicable to be charged for it by the hostel. Electricity charge was 3k per person so 12k for 1 month for a room. If confused ask your papa what is the home's electrical bill for a month. You'll be surprised. That's it. This review was written for a stay 3 yr ago because I wanted to not give bad rep to the business but after reading some recent reviews and how they were mistreated I couldn't hold it for long.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
H Afzal,

Apologies for not living up to your expectations! We take every feedback very seriously & notice that you have stayed with us almost 3yrs ago. We have made minor changes since then & shall try addressing your concerns, through the below points:

1) Small room sizes - Being in the heart of South Mumbai (one of India's costliest parcels of real estate) & with the iconic Marine Drive being a bridge away, either the rooms will be small or the rent will be high. We have chosen to go with the former (affordable stay) since we have several colleges around.

2) Outside food - Since the owners are pure-vegetarians, we had banned outside food after noticing that non-veg food was being ordered under the pretext of veg & consumed inside the rooms. However, the rules were subsequently relaxed & vegetarian food is now allowed after basic inspection. However, we also have an in-house pantry with reasonably priced hygeinic & delicious food. Most of the boys here prefer that option as we offer unlimited food at Rs. 75 for Breakfast & Rs. 150 for Lunch/Dinner.

3) High Electricty bill - Being a commercially run establishment, we are billed a commercial rate by the provider instead of residential. We in-turn bill the same for the sub-meters in each room.

4) Drinking water charges - Yes, we do levy a charge of Rs. 500 for the mineral water which is used for both cooking & we provide unlimited mineral-water for all the boys for drinking purpose as well. You will appreciate that this comes at a cost. However, your concern is duly noted.

featured_reviews.name: Alan K M
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 5 Stars of Disgrace – Seva Niketan

This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. The staff openly smoke, drink, and use weed in areas where they know there are no cameras. Rooms are never cleaned — they’re filthy, unhygienic, and the beds are infested with bed bugs.

The lady at the front desk seems more interested in picking fights than helping guests. They allow cops and GST officers to walk in at any hour, but paying guests are locked out if they return late. Even after taking your money, they won’t open the gate or show basic courtesy.

The bathrooms are always clogged and dirty, and the canteen is outright disgusting — you can see rats running around the kitchen. It’s shocking that a place run under Christian management treats guests with such disrespect and neglect.

To make things worse, they refuse to provide any proper proof of payment — no bills, no receipts, nothing.

A completely mismanaged, unhygienic, and unsafe place. Stay away.

I’m very happy with my stay here and would definitely recommend this hostel to others looking for a good place to stay.

featured_reviews.name: Geeta Mangwani
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst experience at eva by hive... They don't return security deposit, serve the worst food, unhygienic surroundings... By end of march they appoint lady bouncers to get the rent (very unprofessional and mentally torturous) and every month wifi issues, gyser was not working. The most hilarious part is that the security guards appointed to avoid thefts are the ones robbing while everyone has gone for vacations.

featured_reviews.name: Pranav Madathil
featured_reviews.review_text: They serve bugs in their food. Their managers are only around to ask for rent, not when you need stuff fixed in the room. The building itself is falling apart. Very little security as well. Definitely not worth the ridiculous rates they charge. If you're a student looking for comfortable accommodation, please please please go literally anywhere else. I'm begging you.

featured_reviews.review_text: Wifi sucks , a lot of inaction , its egregious that even after paying ₹40k P.M. , these guys dont bat an eye towards the basic infrastructural facilities required.
